```{r}
source("DLLCensusSource.R")
source("pir_source.R")

library(patchwork)
library(tidycensus)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
```

#Headline Statistics (for 2024)
```{r}
# 1. Statewide total dual language learners 0-5
print(statewide_dll)

# 2. Statewide proportion of dual language learners aged 0-5
print(statewide_percent)

# 3. Statewide total dual language learners 0-5 served by Head Start
print(headstart_dll)

# 4. Proportion of statewide total covered by Head Start
print(headstart_dll/statewide_dll)

# 5. Proportion of Head Start children that are dual language learners
print(headstart_dll/headstart_total)
```

#Temporal Visualizations
```{r}
# 1. Change in statewide proportion of dual language learners aged 0-5
ggplot(non_e_517_ma, aes(x = year, y = percent_non_e, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Statewide Proportion of Dual Language Learners",
       title = "Statewide Proportion of Dual Language Learners, Massachusetts, 2008-2024") +
  theme_minimal() 

# 1a. Comparing nationwide
ggplot(non_e_517, aes(x = year, y = percent_non_e, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Nationwide Proportion of Dual Language Learners",
       title = "Proportion of Dual Language Learners, United States, 2008-2024") +
  theme_minimal() 

# 2. Proportion of statewide total DLL covered by Head Start
ggplot(ma_dllenroll, aes(x = TimeFrame, y = dll_prop, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Statewide Proportion of Dual Language Learners Served by Head Start",
       title = "Statewide Proportion of Dual Language Learners Served by Head Start, Massachusetts, 2021-2024") +
  theme_minimal()

# 2a. 
ggplot(usa_dllenroll, aes(x = TimeFrame, y = dll_prop, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Proportion of Dual Language Learners Served by Head Start",
       title = "Proportion of Dual Language Learners Served by Head Start, United States, 2021-2024") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3. Proportion of Head Start children that are dual language learners
ggplot(headstart_dll_ma, aes(x = pir_year, y = percent_dll, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Statewide Percent of Head Start Students that are Dual Language Learners",
       title = "Head Start Proportion of Dual Language Learners, Massachusetts, 2021-2025") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3a. Comparison to United States: Head Start DLL Enrollment percent
ggplot(headstart_dll_states, aes(x = pir_year, y = percent_dll, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "Percent of Head Start Students that are Dual Language Learners",
       title = "Head Start Proportion of Dual Language Learners, United States, 2021-2025") +
  theme_minimal()
```
